title: 2008 Ahmedabad blasts: Gujarat High Court upholds death sentence for 38, life term for 11 convicts
description: The Gujarat High Court on Tuesday upheld the conviction of 49 people in the 2008 Ahmedabad blasts case that left at least 56 dead and hundreds injured, reported PTI. A Bench of Justice AY Kogje and Justice Samir J Dave also upheld the award of death sentence for 38 of the convicts and life sentence for the remaining 11.
